title: KW T909 FUPS Road Train Polished Aluminium Custom Bullbar #54
description: Kenworth T909 FUPS compliant polished Road Train hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. Extended deep heavy duty reinforced main channel with extended box uprights to the base of the main channel plus Cow Catcher lower bar with four (4) small uprights for maximum protection. 76mm pipe with a full width cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are one piece and pass through the drilled uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights are 6mm wall high tensile aluminium for maximum strength and protection. Flip over aluminium combination Road Train signs with machined KW logos plus Flammable Liquids sign mounted on secure plate welded to the uprights. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Main bumper channel with heavy duty return panel to match mudguard contour. The centre bar is a custom made extrusion that will mount a light bar. Optional 88mm or 100mm diameter tube is available on request.
